ui.text:
[Red Hollow story test]

Greenwater, Iron Junction and Red Hollow are playable. The fair is not. Travel to the gap?
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Staged travel]

The supported markers represent the path, not a regional landscape. Continue?
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Staged hoist]

The cage journey is represented by relocation to supported floor. No lift physics or four-minute wait. Continue?
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Bring the shift up]

Every living unfinished miner must reach the cage and surface. This is a staged batch; incomplete arrivals remain pending. Continue?
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Rescue and break]

Choose only what is represented. A pending blast is not completed by rescue.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Inner-break blast]

This closes the gallery break, not the Mouth. Every survivor must already be safe and nobody may remain in the blast area. Continue?
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Seal the Mouth]

You heard the knocking. All eleven are still below. This is your explicit order to entomb the shift. Continue?
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Deadline final call]

The warned active-time deadline has expired. The cage brings you out before Blevins fires. Continue acknowledges the warning; it is not your order.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Local deadline]

600 active seconds initially; 30 after an expired warning is renewed. Only loaded Mouth/Nine/gallery gameplay counts. Menus, dialogue, transit, absence and load gaps pause it. Accept?
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Staged hoist]

Bring the shift up, or return alone. Return alone does not rescue anybody.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Rescue fallback]

The living warning speaker is unavailable. You can operate the staged hoist without arming a deadline. No ghost gives the warning.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Current Red Hollow facts]

Court %g; mine %g; safe survivors %g; observed deaths %g (player %g; other %g). Entombment is separate.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Evidence and undertaking]

Court-payment testimony %g; mine silver %g; personal undertaking %g; terms actually delivered %g. No town ratification is claimed.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Lamp and custody]

Lamp origin %g (1 gallery, 2 cot); presently held %g; 2298 copy presently held %g; entombed %g. Acquisition and current custody are distinct.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Rescue control]

Blevins cannot operate the firing control. No deadline is armed. The hoist remains available for rescue.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Court scene]

Optional court controls are independent of the mine. The bypass is a supported walk around the gate.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Local gallows scene]

The drop follows 15 active seconds here, after a final warning. Menus, absence or intervention pause/prevent it. Watch?
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Imminent drop]

The local sentence is about to be carried out. Continue acknowledges witnessing; cancellation prevents the drop.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Court referral]

The current docket and the held 2298 review copy will be entered together for review. This is not a pardon. Confirm the represented referral?
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Court receipt]

Sixty caps received; the receipt is in your inventory. Release still requires the living prisoner to reach the supported safe position.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Red Hollow report]

Report current court, miner, mine, evidence and lamp facts. No fair or town-wide agreement is implied.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Red Hollow]

Use the labelled controls. Missing effects remain unfinished; no failed move, missing actor or unacknowledged choice is a success.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Unfinished scene]

The required arrival, item or visible effect was not observed. Nothing further is recorded. Use the same control to retry only unfinished work.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Court unavailable]

No eligible surviving earlier-road prisoner is available. Nobody is replaced or resurrected. The bypass and mine remain open.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Court record]

No eligible prisoner's statement has been recorded here. The mine does not require this optional evidence.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Rope attachment]

Use a real player projectile on the visible attachment target. Activating this control does not count as shooting or release.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Rope release]

The rope is broken. The prisoner is alive and free. The forty-yard quotation is withheld; recording and payment of any rope fine are separate.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Rope record]

Quill records the shot and a four-cap rope fine. A recorded fine is not a paid fine.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Knocking stand-in]

This labelled listening interaction represents the authored hoist-code knocking and its slower reply. It supplies no voice or audio acceptance.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Prisoner record]

Only the actual earlier-road actor is bound here. Freedom, living review custody and death are separate facts.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Mine status]

Read the counted facts in the notifications. The shift, current survivors, observed deaths and entombment are separate.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Lamp proof]

A world stand-in and one inventory item represent the lamp. No working carried light or later sale is claimed.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Hoist-house desk]

You found stamped silver and an instruction to keep the Mouth shut through winter.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Return to Mercy]

Unsettled work remains unsettled. Return now?
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Red Hollow]

Red Hollow road complete. All three roads remain playable; the fair is not.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Greybox: toll and court]

Court, receipt, rope target and evidence are optional. A supported path goes around the labelled gate to the mine route.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Greybox: the Mouth]

Hoist, warning, firing control and desk evidence. The board represents current entrance status; no whole settlement crowd is simulated.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Greybox: cage staging]

Supported surface/below markers represent the hoist. Transit pauses the deadline. Every miner arrival must be observed.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Greybox: the Nine level]

Eleven separate unnamed roles stand at the break. One represents the already authored Pell relationship without a new name or speaking part.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

ui.text:
[Greybox: sealed gallery]

Dorn's bounded gallery and lamp. No passage beyond the stone door, player-origin answer or town-wide allegiance is available.
ui.projection: technical stand-in / controls; no added NPC prose

TLM_MSG_A1_PritchardHandOff.text:
Owen Pritchard: "Greenwater's food has gone short. Red Hollow's sealed the mine. Iron Junction's rails are being cut. Pick one. I don't have the people for all three."

[Opening complete. Greenwater, Iron Junction and Red Hollow are playable. The fair is not.]

TLM_MSG_A1_PritchardAfter.text:
Owen Pritchard: "Greenwater, Red Hollow or Iron Junction. Pick one."

[Opening complete. Greenwater, Iron Junction and Red Hollow are playable. The fair is not.]

TLM_MSG_A1_PritchardAfterAndMore.text:
Owen Pritchard: "Greenwater, Red Hollow or Iron Junction. Pick one."

[Opening complete. Greenwater, Iron Junction and Red Hollow are playable. The fair is not.]
buttons: There's something else from that train.

TLM_MSG_MB_Hub.text:
Owen Pritchard: "Which road do you want to ask about? Tell me what you know, or ask what to look for."

[Mercy briefing. Greenwater, Iron Junction and Red Hollow are playable. The fair is not.]

TLM_MSG_GW_AskTravel.text:
[Greenwater story test]

Greenwater, Iron Junction and Red Hollow are playable in this candidate; the fair is not. It is a greybox: flat ground and labelled stand-ins. Travel there now?

TLM_MSG_GW_ReportEndKnown.text:
[River report]

You learned that Hatcher was paid in stamped silver to hold the grain. Who paid is not known.

Greenwater road complete. Iron Junction and Red Hollow are also playable; the fair is not.

TLM_MSG_GW_ReportEndUnknown.text:
[River report]

You did not learn why Hatcher held the grain.

Greenwater road complete. Iron Junction and Red Hollow are also playable; the fair is not.

TLM_MSG_NM_AskTravel.text:
[Iron Junction story test]

Greenwater, Iron Junction and Red Hollow are playable in this candidate; the fair is not. It is a greybox: floors and labelled stand-ins. Travel there now?

TLM_MSG_NM_NoteRoadComplete.text:
[Iron Junction story test]

Night Mail road complete. Greenwater and Red Hollow remain playable; the fair is not. Sheriff Pritchard will hear what became of the Night Mail.

TLM_MSG_NM_ReportEnd.text:
[Rail report]

Night Mail road complete. Greenwater and Red Hollow remain playable; the fair is not.

stages.Log: You reached the Dominion toll-gate.
The rope is broken. The prisoner is alive and free.
You bought a man off the gallows for sixty caps. Judge Quill gave you a receipt.
Quill adjourned after you presented the 2298 review copy. The current accused remains alive under review; this is not a pardon.
The court carried out the sentence while you remained at the wagon.
You heard how the Cutters were paid to watch for Gantt's delayed freight and seize his pouch.
Pritchard gave you his review of the 2298 hanging, with the court's receipt for the evidence. Quill can be asked to enter it alongside the current case.
You reached the chained Mouth at Red Hollow.
You accepted the warned local rescue deadline. The shift is still below.
You reached the Nine level by the cage.
You found eleven miners alive at the break in the rock.
You reached the cut gallery and its sealed stone door.
The shift is up. You promised to respect the gallery line on your own passage and carry the House's terms to the mine. Red Hollow has not yet ratified a town-wide agreement.
The eleven miners reached the surface. You then blasted the break closed.
You ordered the Mouth sealed with the shift below. Blevins carried out the order.
You have a lamp that burns without smoke and a place to say it came from. That will be worth something to somebody with a flag.
The warned local deadline expired. Blevins sealed the Mouth with the shift below. You gave no order.
The eleven miners reached the surface. You made no gallery undertaking and did not blast the break.
The observed casualty count and safe survivors are recorded separately. No all-eleven rescue is claimed.
You found stamped silver and an instruction to keep the Mouth shut through winter.

objectives.Text: Get past the toll-gate at the gap
Find out why Red Hollow chained its own mine
Decide what happens at the Mouth
Find out what is on the other side of the break
